about: Beacon Holdings is a holding company based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Crunchbase says it specialises in the AI sector and lists artificial intelligence as its industry. Funding shown is about 475 million dollars. The business, its subsidiaries and customers cannot be confirmed from the data given. (Limited public information - check before outreach.)

about: Decagon is a San Francisco AI start-up providing conversational AI agents that handle customer support for enterprises, using chat, email and voice, with customers including Notion, Duolingo, Hertz and Bilt. Founded in 2023, it has raised hundreds of millions of dollars from Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, Index Ventures and Coatue, and was valued at about 4.5 billion dollars in 2025. Revenue comes from usage and subscription. B2B software with little consumer awareness but strong startup presence.

Handshake is a San Francisco career network for students and recent graduates, connecting students at more than 1,500 US colleges with employers and recruiters, and expanding into AI data labelling through expert networks. Founded in 2014, it has about 18 million students and alumni users and raised funding of around 495 million dollars from Spark, Kleiner Perkins and others. Revenue comes from employers and from AI labs buying data work. Well known among US students and campus recruiters, little awareness outside.

wiki.title: Handshake
wiki.what: Short human greeting or parting ritual
wiki.text: A handshake is a globally widespread, brief greeting or parting tradition in which two people grasp one of each other's hands, and in most cases, it is accompanied by a brief up-and-down movement of the grasped hands. Customs surrounding handshakes are specific to cultures. Different cultures may be more or less likely to shake hands, or there may be different customs about how or when to shake hands.

wiki.title: Handshake (company)
wiki.text: Handshake is an American employment website for job listings, primarily for college students, launched in 2014. The platform is designed to help students find jobs or internships.

about: humans& is a frontier AI research company based in Redwood City, California, founded in 2025 by a team of researchers from major AI labs. It reportedly raised a very large seed round of about 480 million dollars in early 2026. The company focuses on building human-centred AI systems that collaborate with people. Early-stage and pre-revenue, B2B oriented, with limited public product information so far.
cb_desc: humans& operates as a frontier artificial intelligence research...

about: Kandou AI (Kandou Bus) is a Swiss semiconductor company based in Lausanne that designs high-speed, low-power chip-to-chip connectivity (retimers and links) for data centre, AI and automotive applications, originally spun from EPFL research on Chord signaling. Customers are chipmakers and system makers. Funding of about 505 million dollars is shown. B2B component designer with no consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Kandou Al specializes in the design of high-speed, and pin.

about: Veritone is a Denver-based AI software company whose aiWARE platform runs machine-learning models for media, entertainment, public safety and government customers, providing tools for content search, licensing, advertising and legal evidence management. Listed on Nasdaq (VERI), it was founded in 2014 in Costa Mesa, California, and has raised about 530 million dollars. Revenue is around 100 million dollars. B2B with low consumer awareness, though clients include major broadcasters and sports organisations.

wiki.title: Veritone
wiki.text: Veritone, Inc. is an American artificial intelligence technology company based in Irvine, California founded in 2014. The company provides software services to the public and private sectors, including media, government, and law enforcement.

about: 2U is a US education technology company that works with universities to build and run online degree programs and boot camps, taking a share of tuition revenue. It owns the edX online learning marketplace, which it purchased in 2021 for 800 million dollars. Based in Arlington (Lanham), Maryland, it was listed on Nasdaq (TWOU) before filing for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in July 2024 and became privately held after restructuring. Customers are universities and students. Name familiarity is mostly within higher-education.

wiki.title: 2U (company)
wiki.text: 2U is an American educational technology company that contracts with non-profit colleges, universities, and companies to build, deliver, and support online degree and non-degree programs. 2U is the parent company of edX.

about: Arena is a San Francisco AI platform, previously LMArena, which lets users compare AI models head to head and ranks them via crowdsourced votes, used by labs such as OpenAI, Google and Anthropic. Founded as a UC Berkeley research project in 2023, it raised funding of about 450 million dollars in 2025 and 2026 at a multi-billion valuation. Customers are AI companies and enterprises. Well known inside the AI community, little general consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Arena
wiki.text: An arena is a large enclosed venue, often circular or oval-shaped, designed to showcase theatre, musical performances, or sporting events. It comprises a large open space surrounded on most or all sides by tiered seating for spectators, and may be covered by a roof. The key feature of an arena is that the event space is the lowest point, allowing maximum visibility. Arenas are usually designed to accommodate a multitude of spectators.

about: Armadin is a Palo Alto start-up developing an AI-native cybersecurity platform. Crunchbase shows funding of about 445 million dollars, a very large amount for a young company, so it is likely a recently launched, heavily capitalised venture. Customers are enterprises, and it is B2B with essentially no consumer awareness. Details of its founders and customers should be checked.

about: ASAPP is a New York software company selling AI-powered customer experience technology for contact centres, with agentic AI platform products like GenerativeAgent and AI Summary used by large US consumer companies in telecoms, travel and financial services. Founded in 2014, it has raised about 400 million dollars from Emergence, Dragoneer and others and has a valuation of 1.6 billion dollars. B2B with limited public awareness.

Black Sesame Technologies is a chip designer whose Crunchbase entry lists San Jose, California, but is a Chinese company founded in Shanghai in 2016, making automotive-grade image processing and autonomous driving chips (Huashan and Wudang series). It was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (2533) in 2024. Customers are Chinese automakers such as FAW, SAIC and Dongfeng. B2B with limited consumer awareness.

Capacity is a Saint Louis-based AI platform that automates support and business workflows with chatbots and knowledge tools, serving customers in HR, IT, legal and finance functions. Crunchbase shows funding of about 443 million dollars. It is a B2B software company with limited consumer awareness, known mostly among enterprise software buyers.

Clay is a New York AI go-to-market platform that gives sales and marketing teams data enrichment, workflows and AI agents that research prospects and write outreach. Customers include OpenAI, Anthropic and Canva. Founded in 2017, it has raised about 392 million dollars, with a valuation of 3.1 billion dollars after a 2025 round. Subscription revenue is in the hundreds of millions in annual recurring revenue. B2B software with a loyal following among revenue teams but little consumer awareness.

Datavault AI is a US technology company, formerly WiSA Technologies, based in Beaverton, Oregon, developing spatial audio wireless technology and then AI data monetisation and credentialing platforms with focus on sports, entertainment and tokenised assets. Listed on Nasdaq (DVLT), it has frequently changed its focus and has had significant losses. Funding shown is about 392 million dollars. Low consumer awareness, though it has announced sports-related partnerships and licensing.

about: Dexterity is a Redwood City robotics company developing AI-powered robots, such as truck-loading robots and the Mech system, for logistics and parcel handling, with customers like FedEx, UPS and Maersk. Founded in 2017, it has raised funding of about 396 million dollars, with a valuation of 1.65 billion dollars after a 2025 round. B2B with no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Fine motor skill
wiki.what: Coordination of small muscles, particularly of the hands and fingers, with the eyes
wiki.text: Fine motor skill or dexterity is the coordination of small muscles in movement with the eyes, hands and fingers. The complex levels of manual dexterity that humans exhibit can be related to the nervous system. Fine motor skills aid in the growth of intelligence and develop continuously throughout the stages of human development.

about: Factory is a San Francisco AI start-up building autonomous software development agents called Droids, which write, test and fix code inside engineering teams' existing tools, sold to enterprises. Founded in 2023, it has raised funding of about 420 million dollars, including a 2026 round at a multi-billion valuation backed by investors such as Sequoia, Khosla Ventures and NEA. Revenue is subscription and usage based. B2B developer software with strong standing in the tech community and little general consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Factory
wiki.what: Facility where goods are industrially made, or processed
wiki.text: A factory, manufacturing plant or production plant is an industrial facility, often a complex consisting of several buildings filled with machinery, where workers manufacture items or operate machines which process each item into another. They are a critical part of modern economic production, with the majority of the world's goods being created or processed within factories.

about: Field AI develops autonomy software, the Field Foundation Models, that lets robots such as legged machines and vehicles navigate complex off-road, industrial and construction environments without maps. It is based in Irvine, California, and was founded in 2023. In 2025 it raised about 400 million dollars at a valuation near 2 billion dollars from investors including Bezos Expeditions and Prysm. Customers include construction, energy, mining and defence operators. B2B robotics software with limited consumer awareness.

about: Glance is an Indian AI-driven consumer technology company, owned by InMobi, that runs the lock-screen content and commerce platform on hundreds of millions of Android phones, with Glance Roposo and its AI shopping tools. It earns money from advertising, commerce and partnerships with phone makers like Samsung and Xiaomi. Based in Bengaluru, it raised funding of about 390 million dollars, including investment from Google and Jio Platforms. Reaches users across India, Indonesia and Thailand, though the Glance brand is not widely known to consumers.

Global AI is a New York-based company described by Crunchbase as a hyperscaler focused on sovereign AI, meaning it builds large AI compute infrastructure and data centre capacity for governments and nations. Funding shown is about 441 million dollars. Customers are governments and large enterprises; B2B, with little consumer brand awareness. Details of ownership and projects should be verified.

about: Heidi Health is a Melbourne-based healthtech company whose AI medical scribe listens to consultations and automatically writes clinical notes, letters and documentation for doctors and clinicians. Founded in 2021 by Dr Thomas Kelly, it is used in over 100 countries by tens of thousands of clinicians and raised about 65 million dollars in 2025, though the Crunchbase total shown is higher. Customers are health systems, practices and individual doctors. Known to clinicians, with little consumer awareness.

Horizon3.ai is a San Francisco cybersecurity company whose NodeZero platform runs autonomous penetration tests, finding and exploiting weaknesses in customers' networks. Customers include enterprises, government agencies and managed security providers. Founded in 2019 by former US special operations cyber specialist Snehal Antani, it has raised funding of about 430 million dollars, including 100 million in 2025. B2B security software with little general consumer awareness.

Keel Infrastructure is a New York company that develops and owns data centre campuses for AI workloads, with a focus on securing power and land for large-scale compute. Funding shown is about 400 million dollars. Customers are cloud, hyperscaler and AI companies leasing capacity. B2B infrastructure with no consumer brand awareness. Details should be verified given its recent origin.

about: Mojo Vision is a Cupertino company that develops ultra-dense micro-LED display technology, originally for augmented-reality smart contact lenses and now for AR glasses, wearables and data communications. It has raised funding of about 387 million dollars from investors including Khosla Ventures, NEA and Liberty Global. In 2023 it pivoted from consumer contact lenses to selling micro-LED display components. B2B technology with no consumer brand awareness today.

Otter.ai is a Mountain View company whose AI meeting assistant (OtterPilot) joins calls, transcribes them in real time, and generates summaries and action items, integrating with Zoom, Google Meet and Microsoft Teams. Founded in 2016, it has over 25 million users and annual recurring revenue above 100 million dollars. Funding of about 393 million dollars. Subscriptions sold to individuals and enterprises. Fairly well known among knowledge workers.

wiki.title: Otter.ai
wiki.text: Otter.ai, Inc. is an American transcription software company based in Mountain View, California. The company develops speech to text transcription applications using artificial intelligence and machine learning. Its software, called Otter, shows captions for live speakers, and generates written transcriptions of speech.

about: Polkadot is a blockchain protocol and network (token DOT) created by Gavin Wood, a co-founder of Ethereum, and developed by Parity Technologies and the Web3 Foundation, which is based in Zug, Switzerland. It links many specialised blockchains (parachains) so they can share security and exchange data. Revenue comes from token issuance and treasury rather than product sales; funding includes a 2017 token sale and later raises of about $300 million. Known mainly within crypto and developer circles, with limited general consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Polka dot
wiki.what: Pattern consisting of an array of large filled circles of same size
wiki.text: The polka dot, also written polkadot, and also called spot printed and spot print in the United Kingdom and pois ("peas") in France, is a pattern consisting of an array of large filled circles of the same size. Though the dots must be relatively large ones, and must be all the same size in any given print, different styles of polka dot prints may change the size of the dots or the distance between them.

about: CoinDCX is an Indian cryptocurrency exchange headquartered in Mumbai, founded in 2018. It offers an app and website for retail users to buy, sell and trade crypto, plus products such as futures and staking, and earns trading fees. It became India's first crypto unicorn in 2021 with backing from Coinbase Ventures and others, and has raised roughly $247 million in total. It has millions of registered users, runs heavy advertising in India, and has sponsored cricket-related campaigns. Strong consumer brand awareness in India.
